term: worlds, accessibility and truth at a world
definition: A world is an element of the supplied type W; the mathematical fixture assigns no metaphysical interpretation to it. Frame W supplies only a relation access : W → W → Prop. MProp W is W → Prop, so truth of P at w is P w. Box F P w means ∀ v, F.access w v → P v; Formula/Holds interpret the fixed syntax with a separately supplied atomic valuation. No frame property, inhabitedness or complete-proposition interpretation is implicit.
note: Reuses the existing Modal.Frame and Scott modal embedding for #261; no new source claim or ontology. Exact operator locator: TruthCore.Isabelle.AFP.GoedelGod.Box (and Dia). This is the same raw operator used in DEF-QML-KB-NECESSITY. Symmetry is a separately stated KB frame premise, not part of Box or Frame; domain/quantifier and classical-logic commitments also belong to a chosen embedding. This record is a vocabulary bundle with Frame as container anchor, not a different necessity operator.
